name: MiastoX — Website Deploy
description: Generates static website from game data and deploys to GitHub Pages. Triggered by MCP or cron.

parameters.command:
#!/bin/bash

REPO="/Development/repos/MiastoX"
WEB_DIR="$REPO/website"
API_DIR="$WEB_DIR/api"
mkdir -p "$API_DIR"

# Write status.json (passed from n8n via stdin)
cat > "$API_DIR/status.json" << 'STATUS_EOF'
{{ $json.status }}
STATUS_EOF

# Write changelog.json
cat > "$API_DIR/changelog.json" << 'CHANGELOG_EOF'
{{ $json.changelog }}
CHANGELOG_EOF

echo "API files written"

#!/bin/bash
cd /Development/repos/MiastoX

# Configure git for gh-pages
git config user.name "MiastoX Bot"
git config user.email "bot@miastox.dev"

# Copy website to temp dir and switch to gh-pages
mkdir -p /tmp/miastox-deploy
cp -r website/* /tmp/miastox-deploy/

git checkout gh-pages 2>/dev/null || git checkout --orphan gh-pages

# Remove old files (keep .git)
find . -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.git' ! -name '.' -exec rm -rf {} \;

# Copy website files
cp -r /tmp/miastox-deploy/* ./

# Commit and push
git add -A
git commit -m "Deploy website: $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M)" || true
git push origin gh-pages --force

git checkout main
echo "Deployed to GitHub Pages: https://Dawju9.github.io/MiastoX"
